candidates.label: 006-closed-skip-cy-gauge
candidates.summary: F1 round 6 = parent r05-F1-005 (F3 controlled-partner frame, (P, Z) class selector, CZ(q3, q2) Margolus gauge merged into the tau-fix CX as S CY, rccx + Maslov RC3X bright-flag AND, U_E on the g_r copy and on g_b after the h_b Toffoli) combined with the closed-sector skip of r05-F3-005: U = P = [r_t = 0 = r_r ^ r_l] and Z = [r = 000] are computed right after the tau fix, the corner C2H at c1, c2, c3 run as before, and the c0 C2H (controls F, q13 = g_l) is skipped on Z = 1 by toggling q13 ^= Z around it (2 CX) with T / T^dag on q13 restoring the loop's (-i) relative phase, so the exact 6-CX closed CCH(Z, F -> e1c0) is gone; closed Walsh coefficient negated (psi = -2, -1, -4 sqrt2); rest unchanged (fold rccx(!e2c3, e1c3 -> F), e1 ^= g ^ delta ^ 1, H(q3) + closed-dark mark rccx(Z, q3 -> e1c0), W = 4 CH(!e2 -> e1), 6-term Gray-cycle Walsh rotation on F over (X, P, Z)); 218 CX (-8 vs parent, -2 vs r05-F3-005), T_fixed 196, 52 qubits; all angles linear in alpha, beta, sqrt2 beta.

candidates.label: 006-closed-mark-in-restore
candidates.summary: F3 controlled partner involution in CH form with the kappa selector and the skipped loop c0 C2H (parent r05-F3-005), with the closed-dark mark merged into the g_l restore: H(q3) now follows the tau fix directly, and the second CX(Z -> q13) around the skipped c0 C2H becomes rccx(Z, !q3 -> q13), so the closed dark (q3 = 1) keeps g_l toggled and fails a corner test while the closed bright pair is restored; the separate rccx(Z, q3 -> e1c0) is gone (-1 CX per side) and the rccx phase only flips the closed coupling sign (Walsh closed coefficient v = +4 sqrt2); two savings of r05-F1-005 carry over: the h_b Margolus gauge is CZ(q3, q2) merged into the tau-fix CX(q3 -> q2) as S(q3) CY(q3 -> q2) instead of CZ(q3, q4) (-1 CX per side), and the 4-input AND of the corner tests is rccx + a Maslov RC3X (one ancilla fewer); the U_E phases sit on each Q flag as soon as it exists (g_r on its copy in q7, g_b right after the h_b Toffoli) for a shorter Clifford+T depth; rest as the parent (U = [r_t = 0 = r_r^r_l], Z = [r = 000], T / T^dag around the first CX(Z -> q13), one kappa=1 fold rccx(e1c3, !e2c3 -> F), exp(i theta Pi) = W exp(i theta X_F Z_E) W with W = 4 CH(!e2 -> e1), 6-term Gray-cycle Walsh rotation on F over (X, U, Z)); 216 CX (-4), T_eps 832 (-8), depth_CT 1350, 52 qubits (-1); all angles linear in alpha, beta, sqrt2 beta.
